output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(g):
    # assemble canonical concentric design; infer palette from the component colors
    bg=g[0][0]
    # identify colors (excluding background and border marker 4), center component color
    colors=set(x for r in g for x in r if x!=bg)
    border=4 if 4 in colors else next(iter(colors))
    # center is the 3x3 solid-ish component near upper middle
    # palette by component sizes/locations
    cnt={c:sum(x==c for r in g for x in r) for c in colors}
    center=max(colors,key=lambda c: (cnt[c], c))
    others=[c for c in colors if c not in (border,center)]
    # canonical 9x9, layers: outer border, then sparse, then intermediate, then motif
    # identify 3 as the 5x5 motif when present
    motif=3 if 3 in colors else max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    rem=[c for c in others if c!=motif]
    # use lower-count color as outer intermediate, other as inner
    inner=min(rem,key=lambda c:cnt[c]) if rem else motif
    outer=max(rem,key=lambda c:cnt[c]) if rem else inner
    o=[[bg]*9 for _ in range(9)]
    for i in range(9):
      for j in range(9):
        if i in (0,8) or j in (0,8): o[i][j]=border
    # canonical masks from demonstrated construction
    for i,j in [(1,1),(1,2),(1,6),(1,7),(2,1),(2,7),(6,1),(6,7),(7,1),(7,2),(7,6),(7,7)]: o[i][j]=outer
    for i,j in [(2,2),(2,3),(2,5),(2,6),(3,2),(3,6),(5,2),(5,6),(6,2),(6,3),(6,5),(6,6)]: o[i][j]=inner
    for i,j in [(3,3),(3,4),(3,5),(4,3),(4,5),(5,3),(5,4),(5,5)]: o[i][j]=motif
    o[4][4]=center
    return o"}
